title: Chapter 1: One Thousand Years Back
paragraphs: Pain—searing, agonizing pain—was the first sensation that returned to Emperor Long Tian.
He remembered the betrayal clearly: the Poison Spear through his back, the laughter of his former allies, and the collapsing divine realm.
Yet, as he forced his eyes open, he found himself lying in a small, damp wooden room instead of the shattered heavens.
Looking down at his hands, they were thin, calloused, and lacking the golden radiance of supreme divinity. He was back in his youthful body, a millennium before his ascension.
